items.title: ENA unlock: 93,750,000 ENA (0.625% of supply) · Core contributors (30% of supply) + amount not published · Investors
items.summary: The page puts core contributors at 30% of ENA, locked on a one-year cliff at which 25% unlocks, then vesting monthly over three years, with schedules starting at the March 5, 2024 TGE. So 30% × 75% ÷ 36 = 0.625% of supply per month from April 2025 to March 2028. The page doesn't name the day of the month. The page gives investors the same terms as core contributors (one-year 25% cliff, then three years of monthly vesting). Their share of supply wasn't confirmed on the page, so no amount is shown.

The whitepaper gives the same 12-month cliff (November 21, 2025) and full vesting by November 21, 2027 in one passage, though another passage says May 2028. The docs list this cohort at 6.7%, on a two-year linear vest after a one-year lockup from November 21, 2024. The whitepaper puts the round at 6.23%. headlines.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and Payward backs CFTC in lawsuit over single-stock perp futures
headlines.summary: The crypto firms moved for leave to file an amicus brief defending the CFTC's authority to regulate single-stock perpetual futures in the US.

headlines.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
headlines.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

headlines.title: Upbit to List HYPE With Direct Korean Won Trading
headlines.summary: HYPE gained 1.4% in a 35-minute window around the announcement, outpacing bitcoin, as Upbit prepared to open three trading pairs.

headlines.title: Securitize shares surge 12% in after-hours trading on Q3 results and River One acquisition agreement
headlines.summary: The acquisition is expected to add a new layer of financing to Securitize, enabling the platform to offer asset-backed lending.

headlines.title: Securitize Agrees to Buy River One to Add Asset-Backed Lending
headlines.summary: The acquisition, its first since going public, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

headlines.title: Anthropic to Launch Nasdaq IPO Tuesday, IFR Reports
headlines.summary: Public trading would activate Ondo and Dinari tokenization plans, while existing derivatives would not become IPO allocations.

headlines.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
headlines.summary: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

headlines.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
headlines.summary: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

headlines.title: Solana Set for Another Tokenized Stock Venue as Formation Notifies the SEC
headlines.summary: Operating under the SEC’s “Innovation Exemption,” the firm plans to list tokenized shares of Exodus, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital in early 2027, with the same voting and dividend rights as real stock.

headlines.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
headlines.summary: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.

headlines.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
headlines.summary: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.

headlines.title: Kinetiq Launches Elysium Mainnet for Hyperliquid
headlines.summary: Pump.fun and Fomo say Elysium trading is live, while native HyperCore data reads and fast order submissions await a later upgrade.

headlines.title: NYSE Picks Avalanche for Tokenized Stock Settlement
headlines.summary: The planned venue would retain NYSE’s Pillar matching engine while offering instant settlement and stablecoin funding, subject to regulatory approval.

headlines.title: What ‘Instant Settlement’ Means for Tokenized Stocks
headlines.summary: A stock token and its payment can change hands together, but custody arrangements and conversion into bank dollars remain separate parts of the process.

headlines.title: NYSE to settle tokenized stocks on Avalanche in planned 24/7 market
headlines.summary: NYSE picked Avalanche to supply the core ledger technology for the clearing firm of its affiliated tokenized-securities platform.

headlines.title: Bullish Names Former NYSE President Stacey Cunningham as President
headlines.summary: The company’s planned $4.2 billion Equiniti acquisition would combine shareholder registries with its tokenized-securities trading business.

headlines.title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
headlines.summary: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

headlines.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
headlines.summary: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

headlines.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
headlines.summary: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

headlines.title: Formation Notifies SEC of Plan for Solana Tokenized Stock Venue
headlines.summary: The venue targets early 2027 trading in Exodus, Forward Industries and Galaxy shares, with access restricted to verified investors.

headlines.title: Formation notifies SEC to operate first tokenized securities venue on Solana
headlines.summary: Launch is expected in early 2027, with tokenized shares of Exodus Movement, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital among initial offerings.

headlines.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
headlines.summary: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

headlines.title: Zama spin-off Raycash launches confidential stablecoin payments and private yield on Ethereum
headlines.summary: Raycash has launched its app on Ethereum, enabling private stablecoin payments and Morpho yield on idle balances.

headlines.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
headlines.summary: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

headlines.title: Nvidia perps slide as market reacts to CEO Jensen Huang’s Chinese spy scandal
headlines.summary: Nvidia said its board of directors is investigating Huang's relationship with a woman identified by intelligence officials as a Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Hyperliquid Whale’s 56,667-ETH Long Fully Liquidated
headlines.summary: The two tracked accounts show lifetime losses of about $44.8 million after the trader previously reduced exposure from 93,184 ETH.

headlines.title: Threshold Says tBTC Bridge Has Resumed Onchain, but App Remains Paused
headlines.summary: Aave’s $119.9 million Ethereum Core tBTC reserve remains frozen while Threshold waits for more operators to reconnect.

headlines.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
headlines.summary: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

headlines.title: Bridge’s OCC Approval Opens Path to Federal Stablecoin Trust Bank
headlines.summary: The order requires $45 million in minimum capital and preopening checks. A bank charter does not replace GENIUS Act issuer approval.

headlines.title: What Is a DeFi App? From Wallet Connection to Lending Deposit
headlines.summary: Connecting a wallet does not authorize a deposit. A lending position is recorded onchain, separately from the website displaying it—and withdrawals still depend on protocol rules and available assets.
